theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : 6 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
  have h2 : 2 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
    apply dvd_mul_of_dvd_left
    exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_two (n + 1)) (n * (n + 2)))
  have h3 : 3 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
    apply dvd_mul_of_dvd_left
    exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_three (n + 2)) (n * (n + 1)))
  exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h3 h2
